decisions.reason: As a peripheral consumer-facing item with only limited website prominence, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels than the firm's core technology offers, and even with some organisational slack management would likely reallocate resources to stronger core ventures.

This product line fits the firm's established waste-to-energy business well, benefits from industry growth and the firm's R&D capabilities, and the firm's slack makes management likely to continue it while results mature.

Because it is both closely aligned with the core offer and presented as a flagship with its own page, management is likely to judge it against ambitious but strategically important aspirations and keep supporting it.

Its close fit with the firm's sustainable conversion technologies and its stated flagship status make it likely to be retained, especially in a growing industry where the firm is hiring and can absorb some uncertainty.
